python -m pip install --quiet openpyxl &&
python - <<'PY'
from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
from openpyxl import load_workbook
base='https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S2211124725000117-'
names=['mmc4.xlsx','mmc5.xlsx','mmc6.xlsx','mmc10.xlsx']
headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Referer':'https://www.cell.com/'}
with open('workbook_summary.txt','w') as out:
    for name in names:
        data=urlopen(Request(base+name,headers=headers),timeout=60).read()
        open(name,'wb').write(data)
        wb=load_workbook(name,read_only=True,data_only=True)
        out.write(f'FILE {name}\n')
        for ws in wb.worksheets:
            out.write(f'SHEET {ws.title} rows={ws.max_row} cols={ws.max_column}\n')
            for i,row in enumerate(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True),1):
                out.write('\t'.join('' if v is None else str(v) for v in row)+'\n')
                if i>=12:
                    break
            out.write('\n')
PY
